known as "Clicks". Any person not agreeing with the set mind or activities of the "Clicks"
are out cast within the township and are discriminated against any opportunities
regardless of qualifications or abilities and are made to feel they must leave the township,
made to feel not welcome. Narrow mind set of the township, "Your not a local" rotates
within the tight nit click associations (groups) who portray themselves as being above
everyone else in the township and are associated in religious groups, Rotary Clubs,
Council offices, Local Government Offices, Car industries, Farm industries, Industries,
